The user wants me to execute a long bash command on a remote server via SSH that:
1. Polls GPU status every 30s until a GPU is free (max 15 min)
2. Reads eval results
3. Starts alpha sweep experiments on freed GPUs

Let me load the ssh_execute tool schema first.
Now I'll execute the command on the server. This is a long-running command that polls GPU status, so I'll set a long timeout. Let me use the ssh_execute tool with the full command.

input.command:
MAX_WAIT=900
ELAPSED=0
INTERVAL=30

echo "Polling GPU status every ${INTERVAL}s, max ${MAX_WAIT}s..."

while [ $ELAPSED -lt $MAX_WAIT ]; do
  GPU0_MEM=$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits -i 0 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')
  GPU1_MEM=$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits -i 1 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')
  
  echo "[${ELAPSED}s] GPU0=${GPU0_MEM}MiB GPU1=${GPU1_MEM}MiB"
  
  if [ "$GPU0_MEM" -lt 500 ] 2>/dev/null || [ "$GPU1_MEM" -lt 500 ] 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "GPU freed! Breaking out."
    break
  fi
  
  sleep $INTERVAL
  ELAPSED=$((ELAPSED + INTERVAL))
done

echo "=== Reading eval results ==="
python3 -c "
import json, os
baseline = {'libero_spatial': 66.0, 'libero_object': 67.8, 'libero_goal': 76.4, 'libero_10': 54.2}
for name, base in [('seed1', '/root/autodl-tmp/v7_eval_fixed_seed1'), ('seed2', '/root/autodl-tmp/v7_eval_fixed_seed2')]:
    print(f'\n=== {name} ===')
    for suite in ['libero_spatial', 'libero_object', 'libero_goal', 'libero_10']:
        p = os.path.join(base, suite, 'eval_info.json')
        if os.path.exists(p):
            d = json.load(open(p))
            sr = d.get('avg_sum_reward', d.get('success_rate', None))
            sr_pct = sr * 100 if isinstance(sr, float) and sr <= 1 else sr
            delta = sr_pct - baseline[suite]
            print(f'  {suite}: SR={sr_pct:.1f}% (delta={delta:+.1f}pp)')
        else:
            print(f'  {suite}: NOT DONE')
"

GPU0_MEM=$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits -i 0 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')
GPU1_MEM=$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits -i 1 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')

if [ "$GPU0_MEM" -lt 500 ] 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "=== Starting alpha=0.0 on cuda:0 ==="
  mkdir -p /root/autodl-tmp/v7_alpha_sweep/alpha_0.0
  tmux new-session -d -s alpha_sweep_0.0 \
    "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/acib && export MUJOCO_GL=egl && export PYOPENGL_PLATFORM=egl && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python3 -u scripts/eval_acib.py --checkpoint_dir /root/acib/outputs/acib_v7_contrastive --checkpoint_step 20000 --base_model lerobot/smolvla_libero --suites libero_spatial --n_episodes 50 --gpu 0 --seed 42 --out_dir /root/autodl-tmp/v7_alpha_sweep/alpha_0.0 --conditioning_mode concat --scoring_alpha 0.0 2>&1 | tee /root/autodl-tmp/v7_alpha_sweep/alpha_0.0.log"
  echo "alpha=0.0 STARTED on cuda:0"
fi

if [ "$GPU1_MEM" -lt 500 ] 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "=== Starting alpha=0.1 on cuda:1 ==="
  mkdir -p /root/autodl-tmp/v7_alpha_sweep/alpha_0.1
  tmux new-session -d -s alpha_sweep_0.1 \
    "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/acib && export MUJOCO_GL=egl && export PYOPENGL_PLATFORM=egl && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 python3 -u scripts/eval_acib.py --checkpoint_dir /root/acib/outputs/acib_v7_contrastive --checkpoint_step 20000 --base_model lerobot/smolvla_libero --suites libero_spatial --n_episodes 50 --gpu 0 --seed 42 --out_dir /root/autodl-tmp/v7_alpha_sweep/alpha_0.1 --conditioning_mode concat --scoring_alpha 0.1 2>&1 | tee /root/autodl-tmp/v7_alpha_sweep/alpha_0.1.log"
  echo "alpha=0.1 STARTED on cuda:1"
fi

sleep 5
echo "=== Final status ==="
tmux list-sessions 2>/dev/null
nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,used_memory --format=csv,noheader 2>/dev/null
